definition.def: Supplementary things are added to something in order to improve it.
examples: ...the question of whether or not we need to take supplementary vitamins.
Provide them with additional background or with supplementary information.

examples.sentence: This clearly illustrates the need for supplementary measures if one wants to assist the rural poor.
Only rarely are supplementary worksheets distributed in a maths class.
This involved moving the birds between islands, supplementary feeding of adults and rescuing and hand-raising any failing chicks.
